advisoryFindings.title: Add Out-of-Order Rewind Boundary
advisoryFindings.rationale: The existing tests cover both supported occurrence fields, strict freshness, and mixed record histories in normal chronological order; this is only an extra boundary for an unusual persisted-order case.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider adding a small R7 case where the last/current rewind record has an occurrence time earlier than a previous historical record, if such persisted histories are possible, to pin the rule to the authoritative current record rather than a max timestamp scan.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The existing tests cover both supported occurrence fields, strict freshness, and mixed record histories in normal chronological order; this is only an extra boundary for an unusual persisted-order case.
